edges.description: Constitutive fusion-kinase signaling drives malignant proliferation of fibroblastic spindle cells.
NTRK fusion signaling creates a targetable oncogene dependency in fusion-positive tumors.
Malignant fibroblastic proliferation produces the localized soft-tissue tumor mass that characterizes infantile fibrosarcoma presentation.
In high-grade adult-type fibrosarcoma, sustained malignant proliferation of fibroblastic spindle cells feeds local tissue invasion, local recurrence, and distant dissemination.
